title: Anu's list of weights
description: Seven things from Anu's room, each with the weight she recorded for it.

title: Pencil and school bag against 1 kg
description: Two balances: a pencil against a 1 kg block, and a school bag against a 1 kg block, with 1 kg = 1,000 g.

title: A scale with a needle past 3 kg
description: A round scale with a 5 kg full turn and the needle three marks past the 3 kg label, reading 3 kg 600 g.

title: What one small mark stands for
description: A round scale with a 2 kg full turn, 10 gaps between labels, and the needle on the 7th mark after 1 kg 500 g, reading 1 kg 850 g.

title: A double number line, kg above and g below
labels: kg to g: × 1,000; g to kg: ÷ 1,000
description: A double number line with 1 kg, 4 kg, 9 kg and 16 kg above and 1,000 g, 4,000 g, 9,000 g and 16,000 g below, with a × 1,000 arrow and a ÷ 1,000 arrow.

title: 6 kg 40 g in grams
description: 6 kg 40 g split into a kg box and a g box of three digit cells, giving 6,040 g.

title: 4 kg 200 g and 4,020 g on a number line
description: A number line in grams with 4,020 g and 4,200 g marked, 4 kg 200 g joined to 4,200 g, and 4,200 > 4,020.

title: A double number line, g above and mg below
labels: g to mg: × 1,000; mg to g: ÷ 1,000
description: A double number line with grams above and milligrams below showing 1 g, 2 g 40 mg, 6 g 300 mg and 8 g with their milligrams.

title: From tiny to big: the units of weight
description: Five boxes from milligram to tonne joined by arrows, with 1,000 mg = 1 g, 1,000 g = 1 kg, 100 kg = 1 quintal, 10 quintals = 1 tonne.

title: Times as heavy: six loads and nine parts
description: Six blocks of 3,000 kg making 18,000 kg, and a bar of 450 kg cut into nine parts of 50 kg.

title: 3 kg 600 g plus 2 kg 700 g in a column
description: A column sum of 3 kg 600 g and 2 kg 700 g with a carry of 1 kg and the result 6 kg 300 g.

title: 5 kg 200 g minus 2 kg 800 g in a column
description: A column subtraction of 2 kg 800 g from 5 kg 200 g with 1 kg broken into 1,000 g, giving 2 kg 400 g.

title: Six sacks of 2 kg 500 g
description: Six sacks of 2 kg 500 g with the working 12 kg plus 3 kg making 15 kg.

title: 9 kg 600 g shared into 3 equal boxes
description: A load of 9 kg 600 g with three arrows to three boxes of 3 kg 200 g, and the working below.

title: Cost of 4 kg 500 g of rice on a double number line
description: A double number line of kg and rupees: 1 kg ₹36, 4 kg ₹144, 4 kg 500 g ₹162, 5 kg ₹180, with 500 g costing ₹18.

title: 3 plates to 9 plates on a double number line
description: A double number line of plates and grams with 3 plates and 240 g, 9 plates and 720 g, and an arrow × 3 on each line.

title: A cup of 200 ml and a drum of 200 l
labels: ml for small amounts, l for big amounts
description: A cup tagged 200 ml and a drum tagged 200 l, with 1 l = 1,000 ml between them.

title: l and ml on a double number line, and 20 cups from 4 l
description: A double number line of l and ml (1 l, 4 l, 6 l) with arrows, and 20 cups of 200 ml filled from 4 l.

title: A 2 l jug and a 250 ml cup together
description: A jug of 2 l and a cup of 250 ml with their total 2 l 250 ml, which is 2,250 ml.

title: 2 l 50 ml and 2,500 ml on a number line
description: A number line in ml with 2,050 ml and 2,500 ml marked, 2 l 50 ml joined to 2,050 ml, and 2,050 < 2,500.

title: Adding and subtracting capacities in columns
description: Two column sums: 4 l 600 ml plus 3 l 700 ml giving 8 l 300 ml, and 6 l 200 ml minus 2 l 900 ml giving 3 l 300 ml.

title: Six jugs multiplied and a can shared into eight
description: Six jugs of 1 l 250 ml making 7 l 500 ml, and a can of 9 l 600 ml shared into eight cans of 1 l 200 ml.

title: The market lane: one stop for each idea
labels: both lines times the same number
description: A lane with six stops: units and scales, kg and g, add and subtract, cost and scaling, litres and ml, problems.
